up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2146312 (Bifunctional 3'-5' exonuclease/ATP-dependent helicase WRN). Return assay ChEMBL ID (assay.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values, and order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH wrn_activities AS ( SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.assay_id FROM activities a WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_relation = '=' ) SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, wr.standard_type, wr.pchembl_value FROM wrn_activities wr JOIN assays ass ON wr.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON wr.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON wr.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146312' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000
